area_note: Bandung city, including Dago, Gasibu and Gedung Sate, the IBCC area, Laswi, Pajajaran and Gatot Subroto
intro: Bandung's running groups meet mostly on Saturday and Sunday mornings between 6am and 7am, and many add a weekday night run, usually on Tuesday or Thursday, plus a strength or speed session. Lapangan Gasibu, the field with a jogging track in front of Gedung Sate, is busy with runners on weekday evenings, and Indo Runners Bandung starts its runs from the IBCC area. Several newer crews start from a different coffee shop or store each week, so check that week's post before going. Most clubs announce runs on Instagram and take sign-ups through WhatsApp or Google Forms.

clubs.name: Indo Runners Bandung
clubs.description: The Bandung chapter of the national Indo Runners community and one of the city's longest-running groups; a Telkom University study dates it to 2011. The Sunday run is roughly 10 km, and the Tuesday run is shorter.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram collaboration posts to 24 Oct 2026; own post 22 May 2026

clubs.name: Fakerunners Bandung
clubs.description: The Bandung chapter, started in 2017, of the Fakerunners community that formed in Jakarta in 2014. Joining is free: follow the Instagram account and turn up to the regular sessions. Its Linktree lists WhatsApp contacts for questions.

clubs.name: Sobat Sabtu

meets.where: Changes weekly, often a coffee shop or store; announced in advance

clubs.description: A running and sports community founded in Bandung in 2019 that also runs a Jakarta Saturday series. Each week's start point is posted on its events page, with sign-up via WhatsApp.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 8 Oct to 2 Nov 2026; Bandung events listed for 29 Sep to 31 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Keluarga Cemara Run (Kece Run)

meets.when: Saturday morning runs, posted on Instagram with a Google Form sign-up (e.g. Saturday 7 Nov 2026, 6:30am, 5 km)
meets.where: Varies; 7 Nov 2026 run from Expat Roaster, Jl. Gatot Subroto

clubs.description: A Bandung running community founded on 17 January 2020. It organises fun runs, long runs, trail runs and hikes. Runs are paced, and runners register in advance through a Google Form.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 1-5 Nov 2026; sign-up form for 7 Nov 2026 run

clubs.name: PMS Running Club
clubs.description: A Bandung running club with the motto "Run, Chill, Coffee & Celebrate" that holds Sunday group runs. It runs the annual RunMadhan charity series in Ramadan and has posted strength and conditioning sessions.

clubs.name: BR20
clubs.description: An urban running crew started in early 2013 from a house on Jl. Bahureksa, now with members in Bandung and Jakarta. The directory listing advises contacting the crew before a first run, as times can change.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 9 Oct to 3 Nov 2026; schedule from runningcrews.com listing (updated 2026)

clubs.name: Strong Manis
clubs.description: A Bandung running club whose Instagram bio invites anyone to join its Sunday 6:30am run. A city guide dates it to 2014 and describes Saturday long runs as well as relaxed, shorter Sunday runs.

clubs.name: Freerunners Bandung

meets.when: Saturday and Sunday mornings (routes change each time); e.g. Sunday 6 Sep 2026, 6:30am

clubs.description: A Bandung running community formed in October 2017 whose regular sessions are Saturday and Sunday morning runs of at least 5 km on changing routes. Schedules are posted on Instagram.

clubs.name: Duraking Run Club (DKRC) Bandung

meets.when: Saturdays and Sundays 6am (weekend long run, pace groups)

clubs.description: The free run club of the Duraking brand, which started in Bandung on 3 July 2024 and now also runs in Jakarta and Semarang. Session locations are announced in its app and on Instagram (@durakingrunclub), and Bandung sessions are led by named coaches and captains.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 29 Oct to 5 Nov 2026; website lists an event on 14 Nov 2026

coaches.name: Holspec Runners
coaches.offers: Coached club training: Tuesday and Wednesday sessions with a running coach plus a Saturday group session; in April 2025 it charged Rp100,000 to register and Rp250,000 a month (a training jersey included)
coaches.where: Saturday 6am sessions at GOR Pajajaran, Bandung
coaches.credentials: Coach Handi Elang, who lists himself as Holspec's coach, describes himself on Instagram as a World Athletics-certified coach with a coaching education background at UPI
coaches.description: A Bandung running club formed in 2022 that focuses on developing teenage runners and racing for podiums and personal bests, and also takes adults from beginner to masters level. Sign-up is through Instagram and a registration form.
coaches.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 12 Oct to 4 Nov 2026; coach Handi Elang's Instagram posts, 6-26 Oct 2026; fees from jadwallari.id article dated 22 Apr 2025
